# Plays only for characters of Coptic culture (or a culture that diverged from or hybridized with it), whatever
# their faith (not for Egyptians of the Coptic rite)
group_coptic_moodtrack = {
	subsequent_playback_chance = { 0.9 0.6 }
	pause_factor = 15
	mood = yes
	can_be_interrupted = yes
	is_prioritized_mood = yes
	is_valid = {
		coptic_culture_or_descendant_trigger = yes
	}
}
